issues.description: Default story corpus path points to data/stories, but the repo does not include the manifest or story files needed to run extraction.
Extraction unconditionally loads an external story manifest and files, so --tiny and make demo fail from a fresh checkout.
The end-to-end test depends on the missing story corpus and currently fails instead of validating the advertised demo path.
HuggingFace model and tokenizer are loaded by mutable model name with no revision pin, making results non-reproducible and supply-chain-sensitive.
HF activation extraction performs tokenization without truncation or max-length handling, so long inputs can exceed context limits or exhaust memory.
If tokenizer offsets are unavailable or matching fails, steering falls back to every prompt token instead of only activity tokens.
Preference scoring compares only the first token of ' good' and ' bad', which is brittle across tokenizers and not a robust preference objective.
Validation does not verify that loaded vectors match the configured backend, layer count, or hidden size before computing similarities.
Preference steering loads vector artifacts without checking backend or dimensional compatibility with the current runtime model.
An emotion set with no matching built-in scenarios produces empty means and NaN summaries instead of a clear configuration error.
Extraction assumes every configured emotion produced stories and later indexes dictionaries directly, leading to cryptic failures for invalid configs.
Configuration values are cast but not schema-validated, allowing empty emotions, zero topics, or invalid thresholds to fail later in the pipeline.
